form:FormGroup.label: Theme
form:FormGroup.helpText: The colour scheme for the user interface: Light or Dark. Default is Dark unless an administrator has changed the defaults.

form:FormGroup.label: Layout Density
form:FormGroup.helpText: How much spacing is used in the user interface: Comfortable or Compact. Default is Compact unless an administrator has changed the defaults.

form:FormGroup.label: Font
form:FormGroup.helpText: The font used in the user interface, e.g. Roboto, Arial or Verdana. Default is Roboto unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: The font for the user interface. Default is Roboto.

form:FormGroup.label: Font Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The text size used in the user interface: Small, Medium or Large. Default is Medium unless an administrator has changed the defaults.

form:FormGroup.label: Visualisation Colours
form:FormGroup.helpText: The colours dashboards' charts give their series and categories: Vivid, or Colour-blind safe, whose colours stay distinct for the common kinds of colour blindness. Default is Vivid.
Tick to give dialogs and popups a translucent background that blurs the page behind them. Default is ticked unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Gives dialogs and popups a translucent, blurred background.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick to turn off conditional formatting colours and styles in table rows. Default is unticked unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Turns off conditional formatting in tables.
